items.quote: They know we are starving; so they have left the camp to hide in the countryside, thinking, ‘They will surely come out, and then we will take them alive and get into the city.’
items.contrast: The Arameans are the planners and captors; the starving Israelites are the people they expect to come out and be captured.
items.reason: The embedded thought is attributed to the Arameans. Resolving “we” as the Arameans and “them” as the Israelites rules out the proposed alternative.
